name: CryptoCompare
tagline: Crypto market data API for prices, historical OHLC, exchanges, and news
description: CryptoCompare provides market data for cryptocurrencies including real-time and historical prices, OHLC candles, exchange and pair data, volume, indices, and news. Developers access REST endpoints (and streaming options) with an API key for portfolio trackers, trading tools, market dashboards, and research apps that need multi-asset crypto market coverage.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Apikey YOUR_API_KEY or query api_key=; active CoinDesk Data API subscription/plan required (key alone insufficient after free-tier retirement May 21, 2026)

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free API tier retired May 21, 2026; no recurring free quota. Pricing still lists Personal (FREE, non-commercial) with capped lifetime calls (docs default lifetime 250,000).
pricing.paid_plans: Start-Up: contact sales / preferential early-stage pricing; Enterprise: contact/bespoke. Personal shown FREE with lifetime call cap. See developers.coindesk.com/pricing.

rate_limits: Plan-dependent; published on pricing/docs (free tier has lower call limits)
use_cases: get current BTC/ETH price in fiat
fetch historical daily OHLC for a coin
list top coins by market cap
get multi-symbol price quotes for a portfolio
